description: Repository class for organization-specific watchlist operations, including methods for finding, listing, creating, updating, and deleting watchlist entries, with a focus on blocking rules for emails and domains within organizations.

classes.name: OrganizationWatchlistRepository
classes.description: Implements organization-specific watchlist operations, including CRUD and query methods for blocked emails and domains.

methods.name: findBlockedEmail
methods.description: Finds a blocked email for a specific organization.

methods.name: findBlockedDomain
methods.description: Finds a blocked domain for a specific organization.

methods.name: listBlockedEntries
methods.description: Lists all blocked entries for a specific organization.

methods.name: listAllOrganizationEntries
methods.description: Lists all non-global blocked entries associated with organizations.

methods.name: findBlockingEntriesForEmailsAndDomains
methods.description: Batch retrieves blocking entries for multiple emails and domains within an organization.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a watchlist entry by its ID within an organization.

methods.name: createEntry
methods.description: Creates a new organization-specific watchlist entry.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing watchlist entry by ID within an organization.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes a watchlist entry by ID within an organization.
